statement: We have conducted a thorough review of our transaction records for the cardholder associated with this dispute. Our records confirm that the only transaction processed under this card number was a single purchase of Premium Multi-Vitamin for $74.95 on the transaction date. We have no record of any transaction totaling $533.54 or any multiple transactions that could sum to that amount. We respectfully request the issuing bank to provide documentation or a breakdown substantiating the $533.54 claim amount, as it does not correspond to any charge initiated by our merchant account.

transactionRecordSummary.merchantPosition: We have no record of the disputed amount. Only $74.95 was charged.

supportingEvidence: Payment gateway settlement report showing single $74.95 charge
No recurring billing or subscription associated with this card
No additional orders placed under this card number
